headings: (500 ML) MUSKY LILY HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) MUSKY LILY HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Comes in a container with a dispenser cap.

Musky Lily | Like stepping into a floral garden of unparalleled beauty. Vibrant notes of bergamot reveal the first rays of sun, while the delicate essence of neroli intertwines with the intoxicating aroma of jasmine. A sweet touch of orange blossom adds a sophisticated charm, enhanced by creamy vanilla and white musk. A fragrance that evokes the serenity of a stroll through a garden in full bloom.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, neroli, green leaves.
Heart notes: jasmine, lily of the valley, orange blossom.
Base notes: musk, vanilla, cedar wood.
